_comment: Component inventory for the OPC Foundation mDNSResponder repository.
UA-LDS-Installers project consumes this file to compose the SBOM for the installer the components it includes.
RULE: adding or bumping any shipped component requires updating this file in the same pull request.

project.name: mDNSResponder (OPC Foundation fork)
project.description: Bonjour/mDNS responder service used by the OPC UA Local Discovery Server.

components.name: mDNSResponder
components.notes: Listens for and emits mDNS/DNS-SD traffic on the local network segment. A fork of Apple mDNSResponder, version taken from _DNS_SD_H (5763004) in mDNSShared/dns_sd.h, which is roughly a decade behind upstream - network-facing plus substantially stale is the combination that makes a CVE delta assessment against current upstream the highest-value open security task for this project. Upstream is Apache-2.0 notwithstanding the MIT assertion in this fork's LICENSE.md, which should be corrected. CPE matching against a fork is indicative only; treat hits as requiring manual confirmation.

components.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library

licenses.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library - proprietary, redistributable

components.notes: STATICALLY LINKED via /MT, so a CRT vulnerability requires a rebuild and re-release rather than being fixed by Windows Update on the operator's machine.
